arguments: {"answer":"There’s no single fixed “Linux max threads” value. System-wide maximum: /proc/sys/kernel/threads-max — check with: cat /proc/sys/kernel/threads-max. Per-user limit (threads ≈ processes): ulimit -u (max user processes). Also constrained by PID space (/proc/sys/kernel/pid_max) and available memory. In short: check cat /proc/sys/kernel/threads-max for the system-wide limit and ulimit -u for the per-user limit."}
